_comment: SYNTHETIC negative-test evidence for the Kosli founder demo (demo/meridian). Recorded shape of a test run against a payment-initiation adapter with a stubbed platform: nothing here was run against Al Tareq, a participant bank or any production system. It exists so PSI-R05 checks a real file with a real digest, not prose.
harness: stubbed platform · synthetic accounts · no network

cases.given: platform responds after the client deadline
cases.then: customer-facing status is UNKNOWN, never FAILED
the original payment reference is retained on the transaction record

cases.given: a retry is requested while status is UNKNOWN
cases.then: the retry is refused until a status query returns a terminal outcome
